blocks.text: I wish to lay down some conditions,’ I said. He said, “What condition?” I said, “All my sins must be forgiven.” He asked, “O Amr! Do you not know that Islam wipes out all the sins committed during the time of Kufr? That Hijrah (emigrating for the sake of Allah) wipes out the sins before it? That Hajj wipes out the sins committed before it?” (This second period of mine was such that) in my eyes there was no one more worthy of love, esteem and respect than the Prophet ﷺ. Because of my reverence for him, I could not even find the courage to look at him fully with my eyes. If I were asked to describe his appearance, I would not be able to describe it. For I never once looked at him fully. Had I died in this state, I hope that I would have been one of the people of Jannah.

Then we became owners of certain things. I cannot say how my state was in the midst of these. (This is the third part of my life.) When I die, let no women wailing and crying aloud follow my Janazah. Do not carry fire along with my Janazah either (as was done in the time of ignorance). When you have buried me, cover the grave well with earth. After that, stand near my grave (reminding me of the Kalimah) for as long as it takes to slaughter a camel and distribute its meat. Through that my heart will find comfort in you. And I will also carefully consider what answer to give to the questions of the angels sent by my Rabb,” said Hazrat Amr ibn al-As (RA).
(Muslim)
